title: Countdown confirmation for the OSD and Plasma applet
line: Choosing a screen layout from the Meta+P popup or the Display Configuration widget now asks to keep it and goes back to the old layout after 15 seconds.
explanation: Only the System Settings page had a revert countdown. The Meta+P OSD and the Display Configuration widget applied a layout preset immediately, so a preset that left no usable screen (a dead external monitor, an unsupported mirror mode) could only be undone blindly. Now the OSD service applies the preset itself and shows a small "Keep display configuration?" popup on the active screen with Keep and Revert and a 15 second countdown, reverting to the previous layout on timeout or Escape. The widget sends its presets to the same service over D-Bus, so both paths get the same prompt.

commits.message:
osd: Ask to keep or revert layout changes from the OSD and applet

Picking a screen layout in the OSD or the applet applied it right away,
so a layout that left no usable screen could not be undone. Now the OSD
asks to keep the change and reverts it after 15 seconds, like the KCM.
